validation of serological assays is an incremental, conditional, relative and continuous process.

the validation of serological assays used to diagnose infectious diseases.
the development and evaluation of assays for the diagnosis of infectious diseases of animals.
validation of serological assays to diagnose infectious diseases in animals.
